name.description: Operation name to run. Only use an operation name from discover results or one already in your tool list; never guess, assume, or invent a name — when unsure, call discover first.

inputs.description: Flat operation parameters. Prefer cloudId beside name and inputs; inputs.cloudId is a fallback.

responseFields.description: Dot-notation fields to return, e.g. ["key","fields.summary"]. Filters response.

view.description: Named output view preset (e.g. "compact", "evidence", "full"). Only applies when the operation declares views. Overridden by responseFields if both are supplied.

tools.name: DeferredToolPlaceholder
tools.description: Reserved placeholder that keeps deferred tool loading active; never call this tool.

tools.name: mcp__claude_ai_Atlassian_MCP__getAccessibleAtlassianResources
tools.description: Returns the cloudId(s) available to the current user. Not needed when the user gives a Jira or Confluence link: other tools accept the link's site hostname (e.g. example.atlassian.net) as cloudId.

content.text:
<system-reminder>
Instruction files were re-read when this session started; these differ from their earlier copies — each replaces its earlier copy, and the instructions preamble above still applies:

Yes, the branch is ready to open as PR 5. `origin/tram/sw-589-estimation-tools` sits directly on master and holds only the W9 work: 5 commits and 11 files, with no other PR's changes in it.

**Before you open it, two things to know:**
- **It's fine to open now, but merge it last.** Your plan says the PRs merge in order, 1 to 5. Opening PR 5 early is fine because it's based on master, not stacked on another branch. Merge it after PRs 2–4, then I rebase it onto the new master and rerun the tests. If it merges first instead, the next PR has to sort out conflicts in `docs/pipeline_review_findings.md`.
- **There was no description yet.** I've drafted one below in plain text, with no workstream labels and no Claude attribution.

```
Title: SW-589 (PR 5/5): Estimation stage and saved-model cards
Branch: tram/sw-589-estimation-tools into master
Reviewers: Gilad, Avichai (required); Tony (optional)

What this PR does
Adds a stage that scores the estimation set with a training run's saved models, and
saves a model card next to every weights file. Both only add outputs: no model numbers
change, and default runs plan the same stages as before.

Fixed
- G23: every weights file in model_weights/ (training and holdout runs) now has a JSON
  card with the feature columns in order, the threshold and its metric, the target and
  positive label, the group mapping, that permutation's validation and test rows, and
  the library versions. docs/MODEL_WEIGHTS.md lists what is needed to reuse or recreate
  a model.
- G8, G24: new estimation stage after training, off by default
  (pipeline.stages.estimation.enabled, or lucia_pipeline.py stage estimation
  --run-dir <run>). It scores features/estimation_pickle.pkl with every saved model and
  permutation and writes estimations_long.parquet, estimation_summary.csv and
  estimation_manifest.json to <model_run>/estimations/. Without saved weights it is
  skipped with a warning.

Waiting (follow-up tickets)
- G17: ReLIVE override values, SW-622 (Avichai, Gilad)
- G19: add 00300026 to the database, SW-623 (Avichai)
- G25: which dashboard to integrate, SW-624 (Tony, Lenny, Gilad)
- G15: user manual, written after the other SW-589 PRs merge, SW-625 (Tram)

Questions for Avichai
- The stage scores every row of the estimation set, including other sensor types and
  breaths; the summary keeps sensor_type and breath_number for filtering. Should it
  score only the training sensor and breath by default?
- Do you have estimation work that should be merged into this stage?

Tests
- 13 new tests (3 model card, 8 estimation stage, 2 end to end on synthetic data), each
  failing before the change.
- On master: 488 passed (475 before). Combined with PRs 2-4: 616 passed. The 1 failure
  (SW-611) and 1 collection error (SW-610) also happen on master.

Merge order
Based on master; merges cleanly with PRs 2, 3 and 4. To be merged after them and
rebased onto master first; only docs/pipeline_review_findings.md needs resolving.

How to review
Start with the G8, G23 and G24 Resolution lines in docs/pipeline_review_findings.md and
with docs/MODEL_WEIGHTS.md. One commit per finding; the main code is
src/core/stages/estimation.py and write_model_card in src/core/train.py.
```
